import numpy as np, json, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(I):
    I=np.array(I)
    v=np.flip(I,axis=0); h=np.flip(I,axis=1); r=np.rot90(I,2)
    T={'rot180':r,'flipud':v,'fliplr':h,'id':I}
    out=[]
    for i in range(9):
        bi=i//3
        row=[]
        for j in range(9):
            bj=j//3
            key=('rot180' if (bi==0 or bi==2) and (bj==0 or bj==2) else
                 ('flipud' if bi in (0,2) and bj==1 else
                 'fliplr' if bj in (0,2) and bi==1 else 'id'))
            B=T[key]; row.append(int(B[i%3][j%3]))
        out.append(row)
    return out
